concepts.definition_en: Aeroacoustic, hydroacoustic, sonar, ultrasonic, or related wave-propagation research and tools.
Noise, sound transmission, acoustic comfort, and assessment in buildings, environments, or transport systems.

concepts.definition_en: Construction, electronics, interfaces, fabrication, controllers, and augmentation of musical instruments.

Environmental soundscapes, biological sounds, ecological acoustic monitoring, and related analysis.
